我的生活与购物(My Life and shopping): 一篇关于购物消费的A2短文:安娜与艾米的经历和小计划。
Anna thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Last Monday, Anna and Amy went to the book store. Amy is interested in reading. In fact, sausages and eggs make a quick breakfast.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the book store by bike. Anna wrote about the day in the diary. Life is full of small surprises. What's more, cut the sandwich crusts off, please.
They took many photos at the online shop. Both of them like soup and tea. Anna bought a dress at the shop yesterday. Slow cooking keeps the meat tender.
There are always many people at the online shop. Anna is going to travel to London in July. Anna wants to be a nurse in the future.
